headers:
Detail F on Drawing 200C05 and Detail 1 on Drawing 300C05 specify a minimum
trench excavation width of 12 inches beyond the outside diameter of the pipe.
Standard excavator bucket widths for rented equipment are typically 12, 18, 24, and
36 inches, resulting in a minimum 36-inch-wide trench for a 4-inch pipe. Outside of
widening the trench at bell locations, please advise whether the minimum trench
width may be reduced to 12 inches plus the pipe size. This would allow use of an 18-
inch-wide bucket for pipe sizes 6 inches and smaller, and a 24-inch-wide bucket for
pipe sizes ranging from 8 to 12 inches.
sample:
Pipe trenches shall follow Detail 1 on drawing 300C05. Trench widths will not be
modified.

headers:
Section 43 24 50.10 Vertical Turbine Short Setting Centrifugal Pumps Specification
references anti-vortex baffles - please provide more detail of detail, construction,
quantity or location - did not find any detail int he specification or the drawings. Are
there existing baffles? Are these required? Has their been wetwell issues with the
existing units?
sample:
Per 43_24_50.10/2.05/B., the design of the pump suction bells and anti-vortex baffles
are the responsibility of the pump manufacturer. Materials for the anti-vortex baffles
are specified in 43_24_50.10/2.05/C. Per the pump schedule in 43_24_50.10/3.05,
each pump is to be provided with an anti-vortex baffle. Floor mounted hydrocones
are acceptable.

Please provide the approved shop drawings for the Spirac conveyor that is to have
the covers removed and replaced per revised Keynote 5 on DRAWING 02M03.
The conveyor O&M manual and shop drawings are attached to Addendum No. 6.
